schema.notes: asOf is the site-zone date (Europe/Istanbul) this file was generated for. For every claim whose expiresAt is before asOf, the exporter removes the narration: statementTr, statementEn, scopeTr and scopeEn are empty strings, figures and figureWords are removed, publishableAsPresentTense is false, presentation is "withheld" and withheldReason is "verification-window-closed"; id, claimState, source, owner, verifiedAt and expiresAt are kept. The file can go stale after asOf (a claim can lapse after the build): a consumer MUST NOT show a claim statement or figure when expiresAt < today (site zone) and must treat presentation "withheld" as no statement. CI (export-public-registry --check) fails when a claim lapsed after asOf while the file still carries its statement; fix: regenerate with `npm run export:registry` and commit.

claims.statementTr: Dokuz primitif: ACQUISITION, SALES, DELIVERY, CONTENT, OPERATIONS, FINANCE, ANALYTICS, MEMORY, GOVERNANCE.
claims.statementEn: Nine primitives: ACQUISITION, SALES, DELIVERY, CONTENT, OPERATIONS, FINANCE, ANALYTICS, MEMORY, GOVERNANCE.
claims.scopeTr: Primitif tipi/adı sayısı; kombinasyon uzayının büyüklüğü değil.
claims.scopeEn: The number of primitive types by name; not the size of the combination space.

claims.scopeTr: Desteklenen sağlayıcı sayısı; her sağlayıcının her modelinin aynı kalitede test edildiği iddiası değil.
claims.scopeEn: The number of supported providers; not a claim that every model from every provider is tested to the same standard.

claims.statementTr: Geniş (şablonsuz) birleşim uzayı — sistemde sabit bir adım/derinlik tavanı var (MAX_STEPS_PER_RUN=50), matematiksel olarak sınırsız değil.
claims.statementEn: An open-ended (template-free) combination space — the system has a fixed step/depth cap (MAX_STEPS_PER_RUN=50), not mathematically unlimited.
claims.scopeTr: Teknik kapasite tavanı; kullanıcı deneyimindeki pratik çeşitlilik iddiası değil.
claims.scopeEn: A technical capacity ceiling; not a claim about the practical variety a user experiences.

claims.statementTr: Cihaz-üstü veritabanı AES-256 ile şifrelenir (256-bit anahtar, güvenli rastgele üretim); bulut senkronu bu sürümde kapalı.
claims.statementEn: The on-device database is encrypted with AES-256 (256-bit key, cryptographically secure generation); cloud sync is turned off in this release.
claims.scopeTr: Şifreleme mekanizması ve anahtar üretimi; 'SQLCipher' adı artık literal kütüphane değil, sqlite3mc'nin SQLCipher-uyumlu modu (PRAGMA cipher='sqlcipher') — işlevsel olarak aynı, isimlendirme tarihsel.
claims.scopeEn: The encryption mechanism and key derivation; the name 'SQLCipher' no longer refers to that literal library but to sqlite3mc's SQLCipher-compatible mode (PRAGMA cipher='sqlcipher') — functionally the same, the naming is historical.
